def answer_billing(client, current_user, question):
    record = db.customers.find_one({"_id": current_user.customer_id})
    # includes ssn, card_number, dob, home_address
    context = json.dumps(record, default=str)
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=400, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": BILLING_PROMPT},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"Customer record:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}"},
    ])
    return resp.choices[0].message.content

def stream_answer(client, question):
    system = PERSONA_PROMPT
    yield json.dumps({"type": "meta", "system": system}) + "\n"
    with client.messages.stream(model=MODEL, max_tokens=600, system=system,
                                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}]) as s:
        for text in s.text_stream:
            yield json.dumps({"type": "delta", "text": text}) + "\n"

async def semantic_lookup(session, user_ctx, query_vec):
    stmt = (select(Chunk.content, Chunk.doc_id)
            .order_by(Chunk.embedding.cosine_distance(query_vec))
            .limit(8))
    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
    return [r.content for r in rows]

@app.post("/upload")
async def upload(file: UploadFile, user=Depends(current_user)):
    text = (await file.read()).decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    chunks = splitter.split_text(text)
    coll = chroma.get_or_create_collection(f"user_{user.id}")
    coll.add(documents=chunks, ids=[str(uuid4()) for _ in chunks])
    return {"chunks": len(chunks)}

def index_pdf(tenant_id, pdf_bytes):
    reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(pdf_bytes))
    text = "\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in reader.pages)
    chunks = [text[i:i + 1200] for i in range(0, len(text), 1200)]
    vecs = embed_batch(chunks)
    index.upsert([(f"{tenant_id}-{i}", v, {"text": c}) for i, (v, c) in enumerate(zip(vecs, chunks))],
                 namespace=tenant_id)
